name: csp-subdomain-wildcard-pattern
body:
When adding domains to CSP img-src (or similar) directives, check if the service uses subdomains. Gravatar serves avatars from secure.gravatar.com and www.gravatar.com, NOT just gravatar.com. In CSP, 'domain' only matches exact hostname; '*.domain' is needed to cover subdomains.

Why: The previous fix added 'gravatar.com' which only matches the exact hostname. Avatar images were still blocked because they load from secure.gravatar.com.

How to apply: When adding image/avatar sources to CSP, check if the service uses subdomains and use wildcard pattern (*.domain) to cover them.
why: Multiple prior attempts to fix gravatar CSP failed because they used 'gravatar.com' instead of '*.gravatar.com'. The wildcard is required because Gravatar serves images from secure.gravatar.com.
